newsitem.title: USA: Concord International buys remaining Maxnet stake.
newsitem.headline: Concord International buys remaining Maxnet stake.

text.p: Concord International Group Inc has acquired the remaining 95 percent of Maxnet Inc for $10 million in stock, Maxnet said on Wednesday.
In addition, Concord changed its name to Maxnet, appointed a new board of directors, and approved a reverse 50-to-1 stock split, the company said in a statement.
Concord acquired five percent of Maxnet last year.
Maxnet said it has two subsidiaries, S.E.G. Technologies Inc, a computer peripherals wholesaler, and Savemart.com Inc, which specializes in Internet sales.
